name: How long does a typical kitchen island installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen island installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen island installation can range from a few days to over a week, depending on the complexity of the design and the scope of work. Simple installations involving pre-fabricated units with no utility hookups are quicker. Projects requiring custom cabinetry, new electrical outlets, or plumbing for a sink will naturally take longer due to additional skilled trades involved. During our initial assessment, we provide a clear timeline for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies from a few days to over a week, depending on design complexity and utility requirements.
